integrity: The stated proof is analytic and covers all parameters; 192 exact-rational parameter checks are secondary sanity tests and not exhaustive or an independent certification. The 2002 reference has verified month/year but no reliable original exact public day; the first_public_date is the earliest separately day-verified source among the studied literature (2015 arXiv v1).
scientific_limitations: Finite irreducible nearest-neighbor birth-death generators, real rates and h>0, theta>=1 only. Claims concern ordered input sign changes in one application, not total-variation seminorms or arbitrary graph geometries. Old total-positivity equivalences and backward Euler TN are acknowledged as prior. Equivalent older special results cannot be ruled out.
title: Sharp sign-variation failure of overimplicit time stepping on every birth-death chain
